title: Claude, Make Ace Combat with Tanks
author: katatonicmango
selftext:
No, it wasn't that easy, but that was the initial idea!

  
We used Claude Opus 5.5 to make a three.js game after beating Ace Combat 8. 

  
Things we included in the prompt:

* Easy-to-pick up and fun gameplay
* Casual and unrealistic physics
* Destruction of buildings, walls etc

Things to avoid:

* Avoid using human graphics
* Avoid marketing-type language
* No low quality Minecraft Steve-like graphics

Problems we encountered:

* We used Eleven Labs for V.O. and some characters would change accent mid-sentence
* Cardinal directions were wrong according to the in-game compass
* Sometimes a mission would finish and cut off the dialogue

I would love to hear what you think! I'm just starting this Youtube channel and want to share more workflows, demos, as well as some AI Gaming reviews.
